overal.goal: packages/web/src/app.ts captures `principal` once per SSE connection; a revoked or expired key keeps receiving events for every readable project until the client disconnects, contradicting 'revoked keys stop working within 5 seconds'. Re-resolve the principal on each drain/watch tick and end the stream (with an `unauthorized` event) when it is gone. Cap concurrent streams per principal while there.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Identified during the 2026-10-27 review; not started.

createAuthenticator exposes resolve(c); /api/v1/events and /api/events re-resolve the principal on every drain (broadcast or 2 s poll), write event: unauthorized and end when the key is revoked/expired/unscoped or auth.mode changed, filter with the fresh principal, and are capped at 16 streams per principal (429 rate_limited, Retry-After 5); the UI opens the token gate on the event; events.test.ts pins revocation, mode flip and the cap.

tests.strategy: Unit tests with vitest for the changed module; an integration test through the Hono app or CLI where the behaviour is observable there.
